formula: 70*victory +20*wave-normalized enemy HP progress +10*(survivors/4); not a win rate
statistics: population SD within each role pooled by form count; top/bottom groups frozen from training within each role, 20 forms each; no cross-role character ranking

heldOut.resampling: 2000 paired resamples of the30 seed blocks, preserving all characters and contexts; interval reflects these test conditions, not player-population certainty
